Container.Name: AnimeArr
Container.Overview: BETA. AnimeArr is an anime-first library manager that works alongside (and can take over from) Sonarr, Radarr and Prowlarr: AniList/AniDB-aware identification, release ranking with subtitle-language checks, verified imports, a seasonal calendar and a phone-friendly UI.[br][br]Give it the same download and media paths as Sonarr/Radarr. Keep /config on the cache/a local disk (appdata), never on /mnt/user directly for SQLite safety.[br][br]Default login: captain / morebooty. It works only on your home network until you change it (Settings, Security).

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Settings and databases. Prefer a cache-only appdata share.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Downloads + media, mounted at the same path Sonarr/Radarr use.

Config.Name: URL base
Config.Description: Only behind a reverse proxy on a sub-path, e.g. /animearr
